key.name: icon-on
key.summary: Slider icon while night light is on
key.description: Any symbolic icon name from the active icon theme.

key.name: icon-off
key.summary: Slider icon while night light is off
key.description: Any symbolic icon name from the active icon theme. Defaults to the same icon as icon-on, since the off state is shown by dimming; set it to something like night-light-disabled-symbolic to also change the glyph.
